title: DICGC Risk-Based Deposit Insurance Premium Framework
summary: DICGC moves from flat 12 paise/₹100 premium to a 4-tier risk-based framework starting 1 April 2026.

blocks.content: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) transitions from a flat premium (12 paise per ₹100 since 1962) to a **risk-based premium structure** effective 1 April 2026.

items: **4 Risk Tiers**: Category A (safest: 8 paise/₹100), Category B (10 paise), Category C (11 paise), Category D (12 paise).
**Insurance Cover**: Coverage remains unchanged at **₹5 lakh per depositor per bank**.
